summary: Seven brand sites proven and back, a faster first import, steadier sharing and a calmer colour change

groups.title: Detection
items: Seven of the nine brand sites that 1.21.1 could not prove are back on the brand list, each proven the brand's own by its certificate, its registrant, its own old address or a link from its main site: google.org, verizon.net, dropbox.tech, shopify.engineering, facebook.design, stripe.press and openai.fund. adobe.design and binance.org stay out until they can be proven.
A real word on a risky ending, such as telegrams.top, no longer reads as a copy of a brand on that alone. It needs a second sign. telegramm.top and login.telegrams.top are still flagged.
On a phone, the first sentence of a result stays above the bottom bar.

groups.title: Your colour
items: Pages that were open or visited with a colour chosen before 1.21.1 no longer show half in the old look and half in the new one while the app has not opened. They stay gold until the new look is worked out.
The greeting no longer jumps when the web fonts arrive: the stand-in font is sized to match.
The colour choices keep their hover while the page changes colour, even though the pointer has not moved.
The confirm-email bar on a phone fits on one line, and wraps at larger text so no button is cut.
A taskbar button that is already showing still keeps its old colour until Sentinel starts again. No way to change it from inside the running app was found.

groups.title: Speed and sharing
items: The first import of the scam lists after install writes far less to the disk, so it finishes sooner.
A first visit to the phone app asks for the first-run choices earlier.
Sharing to Sentinel twice in a moment keeps both shares. A second share no longer deletes the first one's data before its page reads it.
